baseline.note: The v6 entities table mixes estates/farms, washing stations/factories and some other organization roles.

officialScaleChecks.finding: Kenya alone has far more official operating entities than the entire v6 global entity table.
Rwanda's CWS network alone is comparable in scale to the current global v6 entity table.

architectureDecision.knowledgeLayer: May contain comprehensive official entities when a stable authoritative source exists.
architectureDecision.coreQrLayer: Must remain curated for human selection and QR usefulness; do not mirror every official registry entry.
reason: Avoid thousands of low-frequency items in dropdowns.
Keep QR index growth controlled and append-only.
Preserve fast local rendering and fuzzy matching.
Allow yearly active/inactive status to change without consuming new QR indexes.

required: Chinese display name or a translation candidate with review status
prioritySignals: frequent appearance on specialty-coffee retail labels
frequent appearance in official competitions or traceable export lots
recognized washing station/factory/cooperative/estate with persistent identity
important for OCR disambiguation or supply-chain traceability
excludeOrKnowledgeOnly: temporary traders with no origin role
same-name entity without sufficient geographic disambiguation
registry-only entity with no expected consumer/traceability value

entityRolePolicy.estate: named estate/plantation; may also act as producer or processor
entityRolePolicy.producer: person or producing organization; not automatically the farm
entityRolePolicy.cooperative: farmer cooperative/society; may own or operate multiple factories
entityRolePolicy.factory: Kenyan coffee factory/wet-processing collection point; preserve the official local term instead of translating every factory into estate
entityRolePolicy.wet_mill: wet mill when distinct from station/factory
entityRolePolicy.processor: processing operator when physical facility is not clear
entityRolePolicy.exporter: exporting company; should not be treated as farm/estate

temporalPolicy.rule: Active/inactive status, operator, cooperative membership and ownership are time-dependent relations.
temporalPolicy.warning: Do not convert one annual yearbook relationship into a permanent timeless attribute.

target.knowledgeLayerEntities: No artificial numerical cap; prioritize authoritative import batches and useful traceability.
target.measurement: Relationship coverage and OCR hit-rate matter more than raw row count.
